name: 2D 6-Connected Intersection Target
aliases: 2D mesh ensuring 6 connectivity with diagonal target
2D mesh ensuring 6 connectivity with outline target
definition: Creates a 2D mesh ensuring 6 connectivity with a diagonal target. It consists of 4 lines connecting opposite corners of the voxel (space diagonals). Note: The text header says '2D_6_intersectionTargetDiagonal' but the function name in the code block says '2D_6_intersectionTargetDiagonal' and the output description says 'ensuring 6 connectivity as a line array'. However, the lines connect opposite corners (e.g. VX[0] to VX[4]), which are space diagonals. The text later compares 'diagonal line target' (8 lines, or 4 lines) to 'outline target' (12 lines). This function creates 4 lines.
summary: The 2D 6-Connected Intersection Target uses four internal space diagonals to ensure 6-connectivity with fewer intersection tests than edge-based methods.
